dataset.response_definition: 100 * EDEP / DEPI (percent paid on interest-bearing deposits)
dataset.split: hold out ~18% of CERT banks entirely for final_evaluate; training uses ordinary 4-fold CV on remaining bank-years (CERT dropped after the split)

library_map.tree_probe: session.run('pre_scan', engine='native') — boosted tree ensemble (permutation importance, PD shapes, H-statistic pairs)
library_map.neural_probe: session.run('pre_scan', engine='neural') — native neural nomination probe

symptoms_vs_causes.finding: year dominates every engine's priority list
symptoms_vs_causes.reading: This is the macro rate environment (ZIRP → hiking → pause), not a bank choice. Treat year as a locked environment control; bank characteristics explain cross-sectional gaps around it.
symptoms_vs_causes.would_count_against: If dropping year barely changes OOF risk once bank structure terms are present, the year signal was proxying composition drift.

symptoms_vs_causes.finding: brokered_share and offices rank after size
symptoms_vs_causes.reading: Brokered deposits are wholesale/hot money — higher share should raise the average rate paid (monotonic). More domestic offices proxy a retail franchise that can fund cheaper sticky deposits (monotonic down). Size (log_assets) mixes wholesale access, pricing power, and business-model mix — expect local bumps if regional competition or TBTF funding channels are missing.
symptoms_vs_causes.would_count_against: A flat or U-shaped brokered effect after year is controlled, or offices raising rates once size is held fixed.

symptoms_vs_causes.finding: top dual pairs involve year×structure and size×franchise
symptoms_vs_causes.reading: Passthrough of the Fed cycle differs by franchise: large/wholesale banks reprice faster; branch-heavy community banks lag. That is an interaction hypothesis, not yet a measured claim.
symptoms_vs_causes.would_count_against: Pair candidates that look strong on residual screens fail the two-SE compare rule against an additive year + structure model.

reasoning.spec_strategy: Start additive with bbs(year) locked as environment, bols for expected monotonic bank traits, bbs for ambiguous size; measure smooths and one nominated interaction against that baseline.

summary.statement: After controlling for the calendar rate environment, banks with a higher brokered-deposit share pay a higher average rate on interest-bearing deposits.
summary.would_count_against: A non-positive partial effect of brokered_share once year and size are in the model, or no OOF gain from including it.

summary.statement: Branch intensity (domestic offices) marks a retail franchise that can raise deposits without matching wholesale rates, so more offices associate with a lower deposit rate paid after size is held fixed.
summary.would_count_against: Offices raise rates once size is controlled, or the offices term fails the two-SE adopt rule.

summary.statement: Fed-cycle passthrough differs by bank size and franchise: year interacts with log_assets / offices rather than shifting all banks equally.
summary.would_count_against: Nominated year×structure pairs do not clear a two-SE improvement over additive year + structure terms.
